data.normalization: per-lead training-fold mean and standard deviation in physical mV units
data.external_resampling: polyphase 500 Hz to 100 Hz before training-fold normalization

hypotheses.h1_shift: Both architectures will lose headline macro-AUROC outside PTB-XL, and the loss will differ between Chapman-Shaoxing and Ningbo.
hypotheses.h2_architecture: The S4D seed ensemble will exceed the xResNet1d101 seed ensemble in headline macro-AUROC on PTB-XL fold 10 and on each external hospital.
hypotheses.h3_calibration: Calibration error will increase under external shift. A scalar temperature fit only on PTB-XL fold 9 will improve PTB-XL fold-10 calibration but is not assumed to improve either external hospital.
hypotheses.h4_subgroups: Discrimination and calibration will vary across prespecified age and sex subgroups within each cohort.

s4d.head: single linear multilabel classifier
s4d.implementation_scope: diagonal S4D kernel at the published ECG S4 block scale

training.loss: unweighted binary cross-entropy with logits over all 16 frozen targets
training.training_crop: one uniformly random 2.5-second crop per record and epoch
training.checkpoint_selection: highest fold-9 macro-AUROC over the 13 headline labels; lower fold-9 NLL breaks exact ties
training.selection_scope: architecture and seed checkpoints only; no fold-10 or external selection

inference.window_positions: ten deterministic equidistant starts spanning the full 10-second record
inference.seed_ensemble: arithmetic mean of the three selected seed probabilities
inference.one_shot_rule: PTB-XL fold 10 and both external cohorts receive exactly one frozen model inference pass after run IDs, thresholds, and temperatures are sealed

metrics.primary_discrimination: term-centric macro-AUROC over the 13 headline labels
metrics.primary_shift_estimand: external hospital macro-AUROC minus PTB-XL fold-10 macro-AUROC, separately by hospital
metrics.primary_model_contrast: S4D macro-AUROC minus xResNet1d101 macro-AUROC within each cohort
metrics.coverage_analysis: all 16 model targets, with sparse labels flagged and undefined metrics never imputed
metrics.threshold_selection: per-label fold-9 threshold maximizing F1; smallest threshold breaks ties
metrics.missing_class_rule: report undefined when a cohort or resample lacks a positive or negative; never replace with 0.5 or zero

calibration.temperature_model: one positive scalar per architecture ensemble
calibration.temperature_fit: minimize binary cross-entropy on fold-9 logits formed from the logit of mean seed probabilities
calibration.primary_calibration_metric: macro average of per-label ECE over headline labels
calibration.reliability_curves: pooled and per-headline-label curves before and after temperature scaling

subgroups.age_rule: PTB-XL age 300 is a documented 90-plus sentinel and belongs to 65_plus; missing ages are excluded only from age analyses
subgroups.sex_rule: unknown sex is excluded only from sex analyses
subgroups.label_rule: within each cohort and stratification, use the manifest's common labels having at least 10 positives and 10 negatives in every subgroup
subgroups.interpretation: descriptive heterogeneity analysis, not a causal fairness claim

uncertainty.external_resampling_unit: record, because each source record is described as one patient ECG
uncertainty.shift_difference_resampling: independent cohort bootstrap draws combined replicate-wise

data_integrity.waveform_validation_timing: after preregistration and before any model inference
data_integrity.required_record_properties: 12 expected leads, 10 seconds, finite physical values, interpretable gain and units
data_integrity.attrition: report every failed record and reason; both models use the same validated records
